name: linkedin-content-engine
description: Motor editorial asistido por GenAI para LinkedIn (MVP local) — script root de dos procesos (FastAPI + Vite)

scripts.schema:generate: npm --prefix frontend exec -- openapi-typescript http://localhost:8000/openapi.json -o frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.schema:check: npm --prefix frontend exec -- openapi-typescript http://localhost:8000/openapi.json -o /tmp/schema.d.ts && diff /tmp/schema.d.ts frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
